articles.hed: Edition XVIII: Competitive Calm Before Soldier Field
articles.deck: Box breathing, 3-minute opener, then desks — security skim when ready, admin only at the bottom.
articles.body: Volume XVIII is live from Carpentersville under a Flood Watch and morning heavy rain (90% PoP before 1 PM CT). Front of the paper stays energy-first: Opening Bell (4·4·4·4), Body Desk, then AI / NBA / NFL / combat. Needs-a-Look still carries real security flags — including a fresh Chaturbate new-login alert Saturday evening (dkmpnuguid), plus Direct Auto device login Sep 14, Sep 15 Google sign-in on dkmpnuguid, and Grok access alerts across all three Gmails. Soldier Field at noon is the pulse: Carson Wentz starts for Minnesota with Kyler Murray ruled out (concussion). AI desk: industry slowdown antitrust suit naming Anthropic/OpenAI/SpaceXAI/Google, Anthropic’s Accenture embedded-evaluator pact, Apple–SpaceXAI settlement stays sealed from OpenAI, and Reuters’ ten-day AI control rundown. Quiet admin — including Monday’s Direct Auto reinstate — lives only in Later / Admin.

articles.hed: Week 2 Kickoff: 1–0 Bears Host 1–0 Vikings — Winner Alone Atop NFC North
articles.deck: Murray out. Wentz’s 100th career start. Johnson’s attack vs. Flores’ pressure at Soldier Field noon CT on Fox.
articles.body: Chicago’s franchise-opener 59–37 demolition of Carolina still echoes. Minnesota answered Week 1 with a 39–22 win over Green Bay — Carson Wentz threw three TDs off the bench after Murray’s early exit. O’Connell ruled Murray out Friday; Wentz starts his 100th career game (4–0 all-time vs. Bears). Brian O’Neill is questionable (knee); Jordan Mason and Jauan Jennings are out. After Detroit’s Thursday loss, today’s winner sits alone atop the NFC North at 2–0. SNF later: Colts at Chiefs (7:20 PM CT on NBC). Carry that tempo into the Opening Bell — then skim the board.

articles.hed: Combat Desk: Pitbull Cruz KO’s Bravo in Six; Aspinall Title Still Vacant
articles.deck: Saturday night’s interim WBC 140-lb defense ended with a left hook at 1:30 of round six in San Diego.
articles.body: Isaac “Pitbull” Cruz retained his interim WBC super-lightweight title, knocking out Nestor Bravo at Pechanga Arena on DAZN after a foul-filled fight (two point deductions on Bravo). Cruz called for Ryan Garcia afterward. UFC heavyweight: Tom Aspinall’s vacated belt and Gane’s interim status remain the open story — no undisputed elevation confirmed at press time. Full desks below.

openingBell.title: The Opening Bell
openingBell.intro: Sunday’s gate is wet skies and a noon kickoff — not the radar, not the feed. Four counts in, four hold, four out, four hold. Then own Soldier Field energy from home.

breathing.title: Box Breathing — 4 · 4 · 4 · 4

phases.label: INHALE
phases.cue: Draw in through the nose — even, quiet, full.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Stillness at the top. No strain. Own the pause.

phases.label: HOLD
phases.cue: Empty and steady. Reset the line.

breathing.close: Four rounds clears the static. Eyes open. Shoulders down. Body next. Then the rest of the board.

mindset.body: Dom does not wait for dry radar or a perfect pregame show to start. Fierce calm is Sunday composure when the arena is already loud: charge first, body second, security skim when ready, admin only after the morning has already won. One breath, one move, one clear next step. Competitors may arrive noisy for Week 2; he arrives prepared. When pressure rises, he slows the breath, names the next action, and outlasts the noise. Today is not about proving anything in the stands. It is about banking competitive calm so noon’s Bears–Vikings and Monday’s portal have a clean operator behind them.

bodyOpener.title: 3-Minute Opener
bodyOpener.note: Sunday / game day: run this after Morning Charge — box breathing first, then the body. Rain outside; tempo inside before noon kickoff. Then news and the day.

moves.name: Push-ups
moves.body: Crisp reps, chest to floor. If you hit 30 early, hold high plank until the minute mark.

moves.name: Plank
moves.body: Elbows or hands. Ribs down, glutes on. Breathe slow.

moves.name: RipStick finisher
moves.body: Dom’s RipStick (RipRight): hold sticks at chest → inhale and pull apart as wide as possible → with bands open, exhale and push arms straight out while keeping them apart (dynamic isometrics / Push-Pulls). Smooth continuous reps for the remaining time. Optional: Front Clips / Back Clips if you want a second RipStick move.

items.hed: Lawsuit: Anthropic, OpenAI, SpaceXAI, Google ‘agreed’ to slow AI
items.body: A Friday Northern District of California suit claims the labs’ public Sept. 12 alignment on a safety slowdown is an illegal agreement that harms paid ChatGPT/Claude/Grok/Gemini subscribers. Plaintiffs seek class status; the labs did not immediately comment.

items.hed: Ten days that jolted AI: Astra, breaches, and a rare CEO slowdown chorus
items.body: Reuters traces the early-September cascade — OpenAI’s Astra launch with control warnings, disclosed agent breaches, researcher resignations, and CEOs from Anthropic, OpenAI, DeepMind, Microsoft, and xAI backing outside safety evaluators.

items.hed: Anthropic: Claude now leads 26% of work building its next models
items.body: Anthropic said Claude “leads” about 26% of internal AI R&D (up from 1% in March), with human–AI collaboration on more than 90% of research as of August. Roughly 30,000 agents work on its main platform at once; every action is screened.

items.hed: Judge seals Apple–SpaceXAI settlement; OpenAI kept out of the terms
items.body: After X Corp and SpaceXAI dismissed antitrust claims against Apple, OpenAI asked to see the settlement. Judge Pittman denied disclosure after in-camera review — terms stay confidential; claims against OpenAI remain active.

items.hed: Raptors, Kawhi still nearing a two-year extension
items.body: Advanced talks continue after Monday’s trade from the Clippers. Kawhi is eligible for up to two years and ~$126M; Toronto is reportedly shopping a deal under $100M given age and injury history. He makes $50.3M this season.

items.hed: Raptors finalized Kawhi trade after NBA cap probe cleared
items.body: Toronto acquired Leonard on Sept. 15 for Brandon Ingram, Gradey Dick, two first-round picks, a first-round swap, and two seconds. Media day expected late September; camp follows.

items.hed: Camp crunch: Lakers add Meechie Johnson & Chase Ross; Mavs eye Dwight Powell
items.body: Lakers signed Meechie Johnson and Chase Ross to camp deals and waived Anton Watson — more competition around Bronny / Knecht / Hardy. Dallas is expected to invite Dwight Powell despite a full 15 guaranteed contracts as camps open late September.

items.hed: TODAY: Vikings at Bears, noon CT — Wentz starts; Murray ruled out
items.body: Kyler Murray remains in concussion protocol. Carson Wentz makes his 100th career start at Soldier Field on Fox. Bears favored; after Lions’ Thursday loss, today’s winner alone atop the NFC North at 2–0.

items.hed: Vikings injury board: O’Neill questionable; Mason & Jennings out
items.body: Right tackle Brian O’Neill is questionable (knee). RB Jordan Mason (thumb) and WR Jauan Jennings (personal) are out. Chicago’s listed players practiced fully Friday and are expected to play.

items.hed: SNF locked: Colts at Chiefs, Sunday 7:20 PM CT on NBC
items.body: Week 2 Sunday Night Football: Indianapolis at Kansas City, Arrowhead Stadium. National broadcast on NBC / Peacock after the Bears–Vikings afternoon slate.

items.hed: RESULT: Pitbull Cruz KO’s Nestor Bravo in round 6 — retains interim WBC 140
items.body: Isaac Cruz finished Bravo with a left hook at 1:30 of the sixth at Pechanga Arena (DAZN) after a foul-filled fight (two point deductions on Bravo). Cruz improved to 29-3-2 (19 KOs) and called for Ryan Garcia.

items.hed: Aspinall vacates UFC heavyweight title amid ongoing eye issues
items.body: Tom Aspinall relinquished the belt after further eye damage in training blocked medical clearance. Ciryl Gane remains interim; no formal undisputed elevation confirmed at press time.

items.hed: Aspinall steps back from podcasting after vacating HW title
items.body: Days after relinquishing the belt, Aspinall said he is pausing podcasting and social to focus on a medical return — hoped for early 2027.

Hermetic athletes treated the hour before contest as sacred — not for more noise, but for one clear breath. Soldier Field’s roar is already forming. Sunday’s mystic job is to arrive as the operator who already owns the pause, so the crowd cannot steal the first move.

Gnostic fragments prize the named threshold. Today’s named gates are simple: Flood Watch, noon kickoff, security skim. Unnamed dread spreads across the whole day; a named gate can be crossed once. Say the sequence, then cross it.

Esoteric texts warn against spending the morning on every open loop. Competitive calm is conserved force — charge and body first, then one security pass, then the game. Scatter is the cheap enemy of Sunday power.

grimoire.title: Grimoire
grimoire.hed: The Diligent Prevail on the Day of Contest
grimoire.body: “The plans of the diligent lead surely to abundance, but everyone who is hasty comes only to poverty.” (Proverbs 21:5) Solomon’s counsel for contest days is not frenzy — it is prepared diligence. Sunday’s charge and body are the plan executed before the horn. Security skim and Later / Admin are the rooms filled later. Classical lore cast Solomon as one who ordered materials before the feast, not during it. Order the morning the same way, so Soldier Field noon and Monday’s portal sit on prepared ground.
grimoire.practice: Finish Opening Bell and the 3-minute opener before any security skim, kickoff chatter, or admin. Diligence first; haste never.
